source: Public Baike article HTML + Wayback CDX (topic/event pages only)
scope: First-seen public encyclopedia text, content hashes, last-confirmed-alive, and disappearance/rewrite trails. No logged-in API. No person pages. The Wikipedia-fork baike-redaction collector stays disabled.
method: Keyless GET of reviewed public Baike article URLs; extract_baike facets; hash comparison against node-local state; CDX digest attached when IA answers.
